title: The 13 Aban march — the National Day of the Fight against Arrogance — will be held in more than 900 locations across the country in a few hours, under the central slogan “Pledge to the Martyrs, Battle against Arrogance.”
text:
The 13 Aban march — the National Day of the Fight against Arrogance — will be held in more than 900 locations across the country in a few hours, under the central slogan “Pledge to the Martyrs, Battle against Arrogance.”"

"In Tehran, the ceremony will be held from Palestine Square toward the former U.S. Embassy, which Iranian officials call the “former U.S. spy den.” The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), the Army, the Basij, public figures, institutions, and various groups have issued separate statements and notices inviting the people to participate enthusiastically in this anti-American march."

"@iribnews"

"**Context for foreign readers:**  "

"“13 Aban” is a date in the Iranian calendar, falling on November 4th. "

"It is an annual official event in Iran commemorating the 1979 takeover of the U.S. Embassy in Tehran by student supporters of Ayatollah Khomeini. "

"In official Iranian terminology, “Arrogance” refers mainly to the United States and its allies, and the “former U.S. spy den” is the former U.S. Embassy compound. "

"The text is from Iran’s state broadcaster IRIB and describes a state-backed anti-U.S. rally.
